definitions.explanation: The everyday short form of {百円均一|ひゃくえんきんいつ} ('everything at 100 yen'), used for a shop where most goods cost 100 yen, that is, a {百円|ひゃくえん}ショップ.

examples.japanese: {百均|ひゃっきん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧、{百均|ひゃっきん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧。
examples.english: I got this at a 100-yen shop.

examples.japanese: {百均|ひゃっきん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{工夫|くふう}すれば→工夫する：22180_kufuusuru⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦おしゃれ→おしゃれ：02515_oshare⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Even with 100-yen shop goods, you can make a room stylish if you're clever about it.

notes:
Short for {百円均一|ひゃくえんきんいつ} (everything at 100 yen). Also written 100{均|きん}. It is the word most people use in conversation; ⟦{百円|ひゃくえん}ショップ→百円ショップ：33718_hyakuenshoppu⟧ is the fuller name.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {百均|ひゃっきん}⟦グッズ→グッズ：10800_guzzu⟧: 100-yen shop goods
- {百均|ひゃっきん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧: to buy at a 100-yen shop
